title: Geometry unit tests (union + slice offset, incl. Y flip)
description: Pure-function tests for union rect and per-screen offsets across arrangements (side-by-side, stacked, mixed sizes, negative origins).

title: Rebuild on display hot-plug / arrangement change
description: Observe NSApplication.didChangeScreenParametersNotification; tear down and rebuild all windows with recomputed geometry.

title: Inject slice geometry into web layer + stage transform
description: Inject window.__wallpaper {stageW,stageH,offX,offY} at document start; wallpaper.js sizes #stage to the union and translates by (-offX,-offY) so each screen shows its slice.
acceptance_criteria: On a multi-monitor setup each screen shows its correct portion of one continuous canvas.

title: WallpaperController: union canvas + per-screen slice geometry
description: Compute union of NSScreen.screens frames; per screen derive offX, and the bottom-left to top-left Y flip (offYTop = union.h - offYBottom - screen.h). One window per screen. Geometry in points.

title: Web asset resolution: Bundle.module + WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR override
description: Resolve web dir from WALLPAPER_WEB_DIR env (live editing, no rebuild) else the bundled copy. Package.swift resources copy the web folder.

title: web/ files: looping video page (index.html, style.css, wallpaper.js)
description: index.html with <video> (muted, playsinline, loop) + overlay canvas; style.css full-bleed object-fit cover; wallpaper.js autoplay kick on canplay. Black fallback until video loads.
acceptance_criteria: A looping video fills the wallpaper window and starts on its own.

title: WebWallpaperView: transparent WKWebView with local file access
description: WKWebView configured transparent (no drawn background) with loadFileURL allowingReadAccessTo the web dir. Fills the window.

title: WallpaperWindow: desktop-layer, borderless, click-through
description: Borderless NSWindow at desktop window level; collectionBehavior canJoinAllSpaces+stationary+ignoresCycle; ignoresMouseEvents; isOpaque=false, clear background, no shadow. Fills the main screen.
acceptance_criteria: Window sits behind icons, passes clicks through, is present on every Space.

title: SwiftPM package skeleton + app lifecycle
description: Package.swift (executable), main.swift, AppDelegate. NSApplication with .accessory activation policy (no Dock icon, no Info.plist). App launches and stays running.

title: Spike: validate desktop-layer window renders continuously on Tahoe
description: Timeboxed: confirm a borderless NSWindow at CGWindowLevelForKey(.desktopWindow) sits behind icons, stays click-through, joins all Spaces, and keeps animating (not frozen like built-in dynamic wallpapers) on macOS 26. De-risks the whole project.
acceptance_criteria: A manual run shows a visibly animating window behind desktop icons that ignores clicks and appears on all Spaces.

title: Epic C: Multi-monitor spanning
description: One window per screen, each showing its slice of a single logical canvas (union of all NSScreen frames), respecting the Displays arrangement. Rebuilds on display hot-plug/arrangement change. See DEC-002.

title: Epic B: Web render layer (single screen)
description: A transparent WKWebView in the window renders a looping base video from a local HTML/CSS/JS page. Establishes the render layer that all visual control builds on. See DEC-001.

title: Epic A: Native shell foundation
description: A running AppKit background utility (.accessory, no Dock icon) that pins one borderless, click-through, desktop-level window on the main screen. Proves the always-animated desktop-layer trick on macOS 26 (Tahoe). No private APIs.

title: Stage Manager interaction check
description: Verify the desktop-layer window behaves under Stage Manager; document any required handling.

title: Verify Spaces, lock/unlock, sleep/wake behavior
description: Confirm the wallpaper persists and resumes animation across Space switches, lock/unlock, and sleep/wake. Document any fixes needed.

title: Minimal config (video choice, mood toggle)
description: A small config.json or env-driven config for which video to play and whether moods are on. No settings UI yet.

title: Time-of-day mood (CSS filter animation)
description: wallpaper.js adjusts the video filter (saturate/brightness/hue) by time of day; warmer in the evening. Edit-and-reload friendly.

title: Sample bg.mp4 sourcing + docs
description: Provide or document how to get a small sample bg.mp4 into web/assets (gitignored). Note licensing.

title: Window-config assertions + run check
description: Lightweight tests/assertions for the window level and collection behavior flags, plus a documented manual run check.

title: Epic E: Lifecycle and robustness
description: Survive the real world: Spaces, lock/unlock, sleep/wake, Stage Manager, and optional launch-at-login.

title: Epic D: Live control (the fun)
description: The creative layer: CSS filters, time-of-day moods, overlays, and minimal config. All editable in the web layer without recompiling Swift.

title: Launch at login (optional)
description: Register the app to start at login (SMAppService). Optional convenience.

title: Overlay canvas hook for future effects
description: Wire the overlay <canvas> sizing and a no-op render loop as a scaffold for particles/clock/reactive effects later.
